description: Chaos-focused adaptation of the latest oxia-db/oxia server dashboards at e629d5fa4879b18d1e4d164853cfa220d9a0010d. Queries match the nightly Stable 0.16 and Beta 0.17 metric names.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (shard) (oxia_server_leader_head_offset{channel="$channel"}) - on (shard) group_right (follower) max by (shard, follower) (oxia_server_follower_ack_offset_count{channel="$channel"}), 0)

sum by (pod) (rate(oxia_server_kv_pebble_block_cache_hits_count{channel="$channel",oxia_namespace=~"$oxia_namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (pod) (rate(oxia_server_kv_pebble_block_cache_hits_count{channel="$channel",oxia_namespace=~"$oxia_namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (pod) (rate(oxia_server_kv_pebble_block_cache_misses_count{channel="$channel",oxia_namespace=~"$oxia_namespace"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

title: Oxia Chaos / Cluster
